<?php

function weakReceive176(int &$value176) {
    echo 'weak-body:', $value176, ':', $GLOBALS['source176'], '|';
}
eval('declare(strict_types=1); function strictReceive176(int &$value176) { echo "strict-body:", $value176, ":", $GLOBALS["source176"], "|"; } function strictCaller176() { global $source176; weakReceive176($source176); }');
set_error_handler('warning176');
$source176 = 1.5;
strictReceive176($source176);
echo 'weak-caller:', $source176, '|';
$source176 = 1.5;
try { strictCaller176(); }
catch (TypeError $caught176) { echo 'strict-caller:', $source176, '|'; }
purpose: Checked eval units distinguish caller strictness for a shared by-reference int formal: a weak caller converts1.5 for a strict callee; a strict caller rejects the weak callee argument before handler/body entry.
